groups.name: Justified — people, places, and touchstones
groups.explanation: Raylan Givens is the protagonist of Justified; Timothy Olyphant plays him; Harlan, Kentucky is the primary setting; and Walt Whitman is the poet Raylan repeatedly quotes throughout the series ('I contain multitudes' etc.).

groups.name: The undisputed social hub of its show
groups.explanation: The Peach Pit is the central diner hangout of Beverly Hills, 90210; MacLaren's Pub is the core gathering place of How I Met Your Mother; Paddy's Pub is the bar owned and frequented by the gang in It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia; The Boar's Nest is the bar that serves as the social center of The Dukes of Hazzard.

groups.name: Fictional TV towns in Indiana — or towns that border Pawnee
groups.explanation: Pawnee, Eagleton, Bal Harbour, and The Bennigan's are all locations or references within the Parks and Recreation universe. Pawnee is the main city; Eagleton is its snooty rival; Bal Harbour is a fictional Florida city mentioned in the show's lore; The Bennigan's is a location referenced in Pawnee's history. NOTE: This group needs revision — Bal Harbour and The Bennigan's are not solidly Parks and Rec fictional towns. See replacement note below.

groups.name: Fictional kingdoms or principalities in live-action TV or TV movies
groups.explanation: Genovia is the fictional principality in The Princess Diaries TV films; Walton's Mountain is the fictional Virginia mountain community in The Waltons; Florin is the fictional kingdom in The Princess Bride (TV adaptations); Vic Mackey is placed here as a trap tile — he is a corrupt cop from The Shield, not a fictional kingdom.
